name: Famine
value: Risk of Famine in Sudan; none newly confirmed
summary: IPC-based warnings of famine risk in Darfur and Kordofan persist; no area newly classified as Famine found as of 18 Nov
state: A joint statement on 27 Oct citing IPC analysis warned of a risk of famine in Sudan in the coming months, and WFP says the risk persists in Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan, with 19.5 million people facing acute hunger and 5 million at emergency levels (Al Jazeera, 2 Nov). These are risk warnings, not a new Famine classification. Searches on 18 Nov found no new IPC Phase 5 Famine classification, so risk alerts keep Watch.
for_you: This mainly affects people in Sudan. Official updates come from the IPC, WFP and UN OCHA.
rubric_hit: Watch: 'risk of famine' alerts (IPC-based warning for Sudan, 27 Oct); no new IPC Phase 5 Famine classification found

sources.title: Al Jazeera — As aid situation worsens, displaced Sudanese worry about warnings of famine

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
